title: Flow clone door → "new similar": the copy lands in a writable target package, by default the paired <base>.custom, never package-less
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 — **re-scoped** from ADR-0146 child 2c on the maintainer's rulings of 2026-10-30, verbatim: 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 · 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」 (Q6: clone is kept only as "new similar", landing in `<base>.custom`). The original body (2c, optional `packageId`, `<base>.customize`) is in this card's edit history. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28237

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-21**) · governs: ADR-0146 as rewritten by N-01, ADR-0070 D5/D6 · lane: `domain:server` · size: S–M.

**Why it waits.** The door's default target is the paired `<base>.custom` package, created on demand by the `.custom` ensure door (epic child N-13), which is cut after the ADR rewrite (#28237) merges. When N-13 is filed, this card's `Blocked-by:` moves to it. ⛔ A dev dispatched while no ensure door exists reports `premise_still_valid: false` instead of building a second creation path.

**Business reason.** Cloning a packaged flow today writes a copy that belongs to **no package** — the scope ADR-0070 D5/D6 retired — and, because the original keeps running, a record change fires both (measured 2026-10-30 on showcase: `showcase_urgent_task_alert` and its `_copy` both ran). The customer's work sits outside every package Studio can open and outside every export. Under the ruled direction, a "new flow like this one" is a new item of the paired `.custom` package.

**Measured (`d6c0a75f1a`).**
- `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` strips the ADR-0010 envelope (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance: 'package'`, `_lock`) and sets no package, so the copy is package-less.
- `POST /automation/<name>/clone` takes a mandatory new name and nothing else; `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` is its only caller.

**Wanted.**
1. The door takes a target package. Given: it must be an installed, **writable** package inside whose dependency closure the flow's objects lie (else a worded refusal in the `DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE` family). Omitted: the target is the source package's `<base>.custom`, ensured through N-13's door.
2. ⛔ No package-less clone after this card: the omission no longer writes a package-less row.
3. The copy is written **inactive** (definition status draft), so a clone never double-runs beside its original; the response says so in the server's words.
4. Contract: request schema in `packages/spec` (Zod first), the route ledger's `requestSchema`, the SDK client and the OpenAPI output regenerated; `Clause-②` / `Metadata-protocol` lines filled honestly on the PR.
5. Tests: default lands in `<base>.custom` with no base envelope; explicit writable target lands there; read-only, unknown and out-of-closure targets refused; the copy is inactive.

**Not here.** Creating `.custom` (N-13); the Studio "new similar" button (N-22); overriding a flow in place (N-11 / N-18); clone lineage (ADR-0126 §9 second bullet).

**Dedupe.** objectui#13270 (clone result offers, console side); objectui#11553 (package-less scope). No other card changes the clone door's target.

Links back: #28236, #28130 (superseded), ADR-0146, ADR-0070 D3/D5/D6, ADR-0010.
